title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: Hold: the prose incorrectly says leader and delegate-manager assignments are the available controls, overlooking the documented storyline creator restriction that its own table includes. The rollout dates, licensing quotations and admin routes are otherwise supported; the audience-management route and one checklist step need minor corrections.
